title: Integrations fail through partial effects, not just bad answers
text: The supplied failure dossier includes unsafe retries, partial transactions, duplicate actions, poisoned context, weak identity boundaries and missing recovery. These are useful test categories because a superficially successful response can coexist with a damaged record or an action executed twice.
qualification: Editorial risk analysis. It proposes mechanisms to investigate, not measured failure frequencies.
